title: Item, Quantity and Pet Profile Settings for Tailwise Autoship Programs
content:
Each Tailwise Autoship program sets its own limits on the item a subscription carries: how many units may go in one shipment, whether the item may be swapped, whether a pet profile must be linked, when a Custom Meal Plan is recalculated for a weight change, and the smallest merchandise subtotal a shipment needs to ship.

| Setting | Everyday | Litter & Bulk | Fresh & Frozen | Custom Meal Plan | Pharmacy | Compounded Pharmacy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most units of the item per shipment | 12 | 6 | 10 | 2 | 3 | 2 |
| Item may be swapped for another item of the same program | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Subscription must be linked to a pet profile | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Weight change that triggers a meal plan recalculation (percent of the plan's basis weight) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| Smallest merchandise subtotal per shipment for the program to ship (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 39.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Notes on the settings

- **Weight change figure.** The percent change of the pet's recorded weight from the plan's basis weight at which portions and box quantity are recalculated. A figure of 0 means the setting does not apply to the program; only Autoship Custom Meal Plan carries one, at 10 percent.
- **Smallest subtotal.** Only Autoship Fresh & Frozen carries a minimum, 39.00 USD of merchandise per shipment; a figure of 0.00 sets no minimum.
- **Pet profile.** The three programs marked Yes (Autoship Custom Meal Plan, Autoship Pharmacy and Autoship Compounded Pharmacy) hold every subscription against a pet profile on the account.
- **Swap.** Only Autoship Everyday, Autoship Litter & Bulk and Autoship Fresh & Frozen allow an item swap.

## Hypothetical checks

| Program | Units requested per shipment | Most units allowed | Within the limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | 6 | 6 | Yes |
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | 7 | 6 | No |
| Autoship Pharmacy | 3 | 3 | Yes |
| Autoship Custom Meal Plan | 3 | 2 | No |

The requested quantities are invented to show both sides of each limit.
